newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends easier vs dlr,steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends easier vs dlr,steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended lower against the dollar, weighed down by the mark's losses versus the U.S. currency, while the forint remained steady against the central bank's resistance level (NBH bid), dealers said.
"It was a quiet afternoon, with a little movement early in the session, when the dollar began to go up (against the mark)," said Laszlo Egyed of WestLB Hungaria. "We followed the dollar/mark."
The forint closed at 178.65/70, down from 178.38/42 at midday and 177.95/178.00 at opening.
The forint, stuck to the central bank's bid all day, did not distance itself from the NBH resistance level more than two pips in the afternoon, dealers said.
Dealers did not foresee anything on the domestic market that could make the forint ease against the central bank bid.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
